summary: A single password can also be passed with its label using --vault-id dev@prompt, dev@file or dev@client-script, which is clearer when an inventory uses multiple vaults.
questions: How do I pass the password for the dev vault ID?
How do I get prompted for a specific vault ID's password?

answer_card.title: Passing a vault ID
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook --vault-id dev@prompt site.yml
ansible-playbook --vault-id dev@dev-password site.yml
ansible-playbook --vault-id dev@my-vault-password-client.py
```

Using labels is clearer when one inventory uses several vaults.
